phone_vibrate.title: Phone vibrating on a counter
phone_vibrate.description: Incoming-call buzz pattern (buzz, short gap, buzz, long gap; one 2.0 s cycle) of a phone on a hard surface. No ringtone. Loops seamlessly: hold it with a cue's until or dur for as long as a ringing phone is on screen.
